display.purpose: The bar's one family carries every role; F-key/Esc labels at 700/24px are its loudest voice.

body.purpose: Module secondary text, slider readouts, launcher entries (~12-13.5px, 400).

label.purpose: Compact widget labels - battery %, weather, caps-lock (~10-11px, 500-600).

shadows.name: glass-tint
shadows.purpose: GUI translucent panel tint; depth is glass-over-gradient, never hard shadows.

motion.name: spring-bounce
motion.purpose: Dock launch bounce / press glow - overshoots and rings (macOS/Plank feel).

motion.name: pulse-breathing
motion.purpose: Running-app halo breathing in sync across dock icons.

motion.name: layer-in
motion.purpose: Entering layer eases in (fade or slide).

components.name: Function Key (bar)
components.description: The bar's core key: neutral Iron surface, 2px Carbon hairline, 10px radius, 700/24px Ash Slate label.
components.css: .ds-key { font-family: 'IosevkaTerm Nerd Font', sans-serif; background: #373737; color: #cccccc; border: 2px solid #171717; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; transition: background 0.1s; } .ds-key:hover, .ds-key:active { background: #474747; }

components.name: Esc Key (wide bar)
components.description: Fixed 110px Esc on wide bars (>=2170px), same key anatomy but lowercase label.
components.css: .ds-esc { font-family: 'IosevkaTerm Nerd Font', sans-serif; background: #373737; color: #cccccc; border: 2px solid #171717; border-radius: 10px; width: 110px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-esc:active { background: #474747; }

components.name: Dock Slot
components.description: A dock slot: 48px icon, 14px radius slot, running-app halo breathes behind, launch bounce overshoot.
components.html: <button class="ds-dock" title="Firefox"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="48" height="48" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5" fill="#5b8def"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-dock { position: relative; width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dock::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(125,211,252,0); transition: all 0.3s; z-index: 0; } .ds-dock:hover::before, .ds-dock:active::before { background: rgba(125,211,252,0.18); transform: scale(1.15); } .ds-dock svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; transition: transform 0.24s; } .ds-dock:active svg { transform: translateY(-6px); animation: ds-bounce 0.5s; } @keyframes ds-bounce { 0%{transform:translateY(0)} 30%{transform:translateY(-12px)} 60%{transform:translateY(-4px)} 100%{transform:translateY(0)} }

components.name: Media Module / Card
components.description: A content module on the bar: stepped Iron surface, 10px radius, 2px hairline - depth is tonal, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-module { font-family:'IosevkaTerm Nerd Font', sans-serif; background:#373737; border:2px solid #171717; border-radius:10px; padding:8px 10px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; color:#cccccc; } .ds-module-title { font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#cccccc; } .ds-module-sub { font-size:11px; font-weight:400; color:#94a3b8; }

components.name: GUI Primary Button (config-gui/install-gui)
components.description: The GUI's confident action: cyan-violet gradient block, 6px radius, 650-weight on Deep Indigo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Cantarell', 'Noto Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7dd3fc, #a78bfa); color: #0b0f14; border: none; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7dd3fc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { filter: grayscale(0.8); opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: GUI Glass Panel (config-gui sidebar)
components.description: The GUI's signature surface: tinted glass + 18px backdrop blur over the ambient gradient, 10px radius.
components.css: .ds-panel { font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Cantarell', 'Noto Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; background: rgba(23,26,33,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); border: 1px solid #2a2f3b; border-radius: 10px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; color: #eef0f3; width: 240px; } .ds-panel-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 20px 18px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border-bottom: 1px solid #20242e; } .ds-panel-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 3px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7dd3fc, #a78bfa); } .ds-panel-nav { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; color: #939bad; } .ds-panel-nav:hover { color: #eef0f3; }

components.name: GUI Search Input (config-gui)
components.description: Near-black field, 1px hairline, 6px radius; focus shifts the border to Aqua Cyan.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #0d0f14; border: 1px solid #2a2f3b; color: #eef0f3; border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: inherit; transition: border-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c6377; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7dd3fc; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #7dd3fc; }

narrative.overview:
react-drm is a dense, dark, glass-and-token system that lives on two canvases: the physical Touch Bar (a 2008-2170px by ~60px DRM panel) and the desktop GUI shells (config-gui, install-gui) that configure it. On the bar, the identity is black glass over the machine: #000000 backgrounds, subtly graded #373737/#474747 module surfaces, a single crisp 2px hairline border, and one restrained blue (#5b8def) accent for interactivity. Every pixel is accounted for - the bar has almost no room, so the system buys legibility through contrast between a true-black field and stepped mid-dark surfaces, and buys motion through springs that overshoot (ring) like macOS.

The GUI shells are the bar's control room and share its DNA without pretending to be the hardware: a near-black indigo (#0d0f14) canvas with translucent glass panels (rgba(23,26,33,0.55) + blur(18px)) over faint cyan/violet ambient gradients, and a single bright cyan-to-violet accent gradient (#7dd3fc -> #a78bfa) reserved for primary action blocks and the active state. Both canvases speak the same grammar - dark module on darker field, hairline dividers, one bright accent, radius in the 6-14px band.

The system is fundamentally tonal, not shadowed: depth on the bar comes from layered mid-greys over black, and in the GUI from translucent tint + backdrop blur, never hard shadows. Text is a three-tier slate scale (#cccccc -> #94a3b8 -> #64748b on the bar; #eef0f3 -> #939bad -> #5c6377 in the GUI). Status is a single consistent traffic-light of semantic accents - success/warning/error/info - used identically across both worlds.
keyCharacteristics: True-black hardware canvas with stepped mid-dark module surfaces - contrast through layering, not light.
One restrained primary accent per surface (#5b8def on the bar, cyan/violet gradient in the GUI).
Hairline 2px borders and dividers; radius band 6-14px, more for motion halos.
Springs overshoot and ring (launch bounce, press glow); continuous values breathe in sync.
Text is a three-tier slate scale; status is one persistent traffic-light system.
Fixed safe-area insets (11px horizontal, 2px vertical) defend against pixel-shift clipping on the hardware panel.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Each surface carries exactly one voice of bright accent - the bar uses Soft Accord Blue alone, the GUI uses the cyan-to-violet gradient alone. Secondary and status colors never compete with it.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: On the bar, one typeface (Iosevka Term Nerd Font) carries every weight and role. Hierarchy is made by weight, size, and color - never by adding a second family.

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Tint Rule
rules.body: Where a surface needs to recede or host layered content, use translucent tint + blur over the ambient gradient (GUI), or a solid one-rung-lighter module fill (bar) - never a drop shadow to fake height.

rules.name: The 2px Hairline Rule
rules.body: Any border on the bar is exactly 2px, colored border/divider. No heavier borders, no sharp 0px hairlines - the crisp edge is what separates interactive modules from the #000000 field.

dos: Do keep the bar's field pure #000000 and let modules step up one rung (#373737 -> #474747) for any elevation or press state.
Do use exactly one accent per surface - Soft Accord Blue on the bar, cyan-to-violet gradient in the GUI - and reserve it for interactive/live states.
Do respect the fixed safe areas (11px horizontal, 2px vertical) and the wide-bar Esc math (layout.tsx): the content never draws under the panel curve.
Do use spring overshoot for physical, weighted motion (launch bounce, press glow) and 1100ms-family continuous values for background breathe.
Do keep text on the three-tier slate scale (textPrimary/textSecondary/textDisabled), and status to the traffic-light set (success/warning/error/info), identically across bar and GUI.
Do use the 2px hairline (border) to separate interactive modules from the #000000 field, and the Glass-Over-Tint approach (translucent --glass + blur(18px)) over an ambient gradient for GUI depth.
donts: Don't add drop shadows on the bar, or hard shadows in the GUI - depth is tonal/glass, not shadow-graphy.
Don't introduce a second typeface to the bar; Iosevka Term Nerd Font covers every role.
Don't invent a new accent or a new semantic status color beyond the traffic-light set - one accent and one status language, everywhere.
Don't wrap button press feedback in a slow fade; press feedback is a surfaceVariant color swap with a ~100ms flash, and scroll-passing must never light a key.
Don't use radius outside the 6-14px band for bounding surfaces, or apply the GUI gradient as a text/border treatment on the bar's #000000 keys.
